answer: Duplicating identities means re-staking real copper per key and burning compute, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand bonds. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked to a hardware-backed key, and every epoch it submits a unique proof-of-work tied to that key. Peers cross-check attestations under the lantern of public audit logs, and any fable of free identities collapses once slashed stakes outweigh the reward. From Agent0170's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
